projectDescription: A dark-themed online bookstore frontend built with HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap 5, featuring a book catalog with filters, rankings, book detail pages, and user authentication forms.
keyFeatures: Dark-themed book catalog with genre, label, price, and author filters
Book detail page with synopsis, tags, reactions, comments, and related books
Book ranking system with tabs for most visited, most sold, and highest rated books
Reusable HTML components (navbar, carousel, footer) loaded dynamically via fetch
User authentication pages (login and registration forms)
Promotional hero carousel with featured books on the homepage
publicApiSurface: filtrar() — filters the book catalog based on selected genre, label, price, author, and search text
limpiarFiltros() — resets all catalog filters by reloading the page
render(data) — renders a list of book cards into the catalog grid
renderRecomendados() — renders a random selection of 5 recommended books
loadComponent(url, elementId, callback) — dynamically loads an HTML partial into a DOM element
renderAllGrids() — renders all three ranking grids (visitados, vendidos, valorados)
initTabs() — initializes tab switching behavior on the ranking page
initFilter() — initializes the time-period filter dropdown on the ranking page
